text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-usw2 (gateway.5xx_rate). Spike started ~2024-08-17T02:15:00Z.
incidentbot: Details: rate jumped 0.3% -> 8% in last 2m. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Runbook: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx>.
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-761234 opened and paging rotation. Escalation policy: inference-prod.
sre-alex: acked. I'm on it — checking dashboards (latency, 5xx by route, kvcache evictions).
sre-alex: quick snapshot: ingress traffic steady, backend GPU pools normal, auth-proxy showing a flood of upstream 502s.
eng-ben: noticed a canary deploy to auth-proxy ~15m ago (nodes: proxy-canary-*). Suspecting regression.
sre-alex: grabbing recent traces, sampling trace ids: trace/0a1b2c.. - many show upstream reset at proxy layer.
eng-ben: rolling back canary now -> `kubectl -n proxy rollout undo deploy/auth-proxy-canary`
infra-dave: scaling auth-proxy pool +2 pods, increasing readiness threshold so we don't send steady traffic to warmup pods.
support-carol: customers pinging support about 502s and timeouts; compiling list for status page (customer-ids).
eng-ben: rollback complete. Logs show OOM and connection reset in proxy container before rollback. Might be concurrency change in new image. Pushing a temporary tune: set PROXY_MAX_CONNS=100 (--patch deployment).
incidentbot: Auto-mitigation applied: traffic-slicer reroute set to divert 25% traffic away from proxy-canary region to fallback-usw1 for 10m.
sre-alex: 5xx rate trending down: 8% -> 1.1% over 6m. Still seeing isolated spikes tied to older sessions.
infra-dave: also enabled short-term connection re-use disable on proxy to reduce malformed keepalive reuse (`KEEPALIVE=off`) on the warm nodes.
support-carol: status draft ready: "We experienced an elevated error rate affecting inference endpoints in US-WEST2. A canary proxy rollout triggered partial 502s; we've rolled back and mitigations are in place. Customers may see brief errors; full recovery in progress." Will publish after SRE review.
sre-alex: Confirmed partial recovery, will keep monitoring for 30m. Assigning postmortem to eng-ben.
eng-ben: taking postmortem. Initial action items: add canary concurrency guard, add OOM alert on proxy init, augment pre-merge load test for proxy changes.
support-carol: publishing status now.
incidentbot: PagerDuty incident INC-761234 status: acknowledged -> in progress.
sre-alex: marking as resolved to handoff once 30m stable window passes.
support-carol: customers updated, Slack #customers-notify pinged. :thumbsup:
eng-ben: thanks all — follow-up doc will include exact image diff and the rollout timeline.
incidentbot: Incident closed (stable for 35m). Closing incident INC-761234.
eng-ben: postmortem owner noted. Will schedule write-up and link to runbook patches.
